# Character heights (size pass)

Scale: 1 block = 100 cm. "Model height" = highest cube top (y/16) in the rest pose, so it includes hair spikes, horns, ears and ornaments.
Hitbox ≈ 0.25 × model height wide (min 0.6) and 0.88 × model height tall (`registry/ModEntities.java`).
Rescale tool: `python3 tools/bbgen/rescale.py <file.bbmodel> <factor> | --height <blocks>`. Run it with no arguments for the self-check.
**Note:** a model regenerated by `tools/bbgen/chars/<name>.py` comes back at its old size. Run rescale again after regenerating.

Sources:
- [FPE wiki – Miss Circle](https://fundamental-paper-education.fandom.com/wiki/Miss_Circle): 9'7" / 292 cm.
- [FPE wiki – Fen](https://fundamental-paper-education.fandom.com/wiki/Fen): 10' / 304 cm. The user's chart gives 305 cm.
- User-supplied height chart: Fen 305, Miss Circle 292, Miss Grace 273, Miss Sasha 216, Kevin 180, Abbie 157 cm.
- Fan wikis and character bots: Miss Thavel 8'0"–8'2" (244–249 cm; [Gumpsterverse wiki](https://gumpsterverse.fandom.com/wiki/Miss_Thavel), [shapes.inc](https://shapes.inc/missthavel-5scw)). Miss Bloomie 6'5"–6'6" (196–198 cm; [shapes.inc](https://shapes.inc/missbloomiebyhairly)). The FPE wiki says Bloomie is the shortest of the three teachers.
- `docs/ref/confirmed/mutants_sheet.png`: a lineup of the five mutants drawn at one scale. Pixel heights were converted to blocks with Abbie's body set to 157 cm.
- The FPE wiki pages themselves could not be fetched (HTTP 402). All other values are estimates from the confirmed art.

Shadow radii (`BbModel.load` in `*Spec.java`) were scaled by the same factor for every rescaled model.
Ability reach values were not changed. The largest relative change is mutant_engel: 3.8-block melee reach on a 2.2-block body, which is still plausible.
